releaseTitle: ATalk v3.5.1 — Master Core Upgrades: Animation, GPU Graphics & Structure
releaseNotes:
• 01 Shared-Element Container Morph: Organic zero-cut spring expansion when tapping message media thumbnails into MediaLightboxDialog.
• 02 Bowstring Elastic Swipe-to-Reply: Non-linear Hooke's-law spring resistance with coiling cyan reply arrow and magnetic tactile haptics.
• 03 AGSL Chromatic Glass Shader: Hardware optical refraction (n=1.33) & chromatic dispersion on Android 13+.
• 04 OLED Heat-Dissolve Particles: Thermal ember sparks and rising particles disintegrating expired ephemeral burner messages.
• 05 Floating Capsule Command Dock: Elevated acrylic command dock hovering 12dp above the gesture bar across Chats, Updates, and Calls.
• 06 Multi-Layered Card Stacking: Progressive depth scaling (94%) and dimming for stacked modal sheets.
• 07 Spatial Island Header: Contextual dynamic HUD pill morphing between idle contact info, peer typing waveforms, and audio controls.
• 08 Modular Bento-Grid Media Vault: Asymmetric high-density tiles in Contact Details (Voice Reel, Media Cluster, Encrypted Docs, Geo Radar).
• 09 Contextual Radial Thumb-Radar: Ergonomic thumb-arc fan dial for 1-touch media, documents, and tool selection.
• 10 Adaptive Dual-Pane Foldable Layout: Dual-pane 35%/65% split for tablets and foldables, seamlessly collapsing on phones.
• 11 'Omni-Drawer' Left-Edge Tactical HUD: Bezel-swipe acrylic drawer with workspace switcher, live Supabase ping, and fast theme switcher.
